cohort: Fifty women with oligohydramnios (AFI < 5 cm) at or beyond 34 weeks gestation were compared to 50 age- and parity-matched controls with normal AFI (5-25 cm) also at or beyond 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI < 5 cm) at or beyond 34 weeks gestation was associated with an increased incidence of non-reassuring fetal heart rate, cesarean delivery, low birth weight, fetal growth restriction, and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section due to fetal distress, and no specific route of delivery could be recommended for isolated oligohydramnios.
